'''House Ravenshade''' is the house of '''information''': he who knows most needs least. The house sees the realm as a web of secrets, debts, and desires — pull the right thread and an entire house moves. Its craft is to be indispensable: everyone else has more to lose from Ravenshade's fall than to gain from its success.

== Philosophy and reputation ==
Ravenshade rules from parlors, not throne rooms, and its power is proverbially ''borrowed, never owned'' — it rules through alliances, and by whispering in the ears of stronger shoulders. The realm whispers back that borrowed power can be recalled.

== Customs ==
* '''The Banquet''' — a feast on the surface, an information market in truth; secrets, debts, and alliances traded over wine and music.
* '''The archives''' — correspondence, ciphers, and debt records: the house's true treasury. It never leaks.

== The seat ==
[[Duskport]] is not a fortress but a harbor town the house permeates. Rumor holds that sound travels strangely through the older quarters — '''the Ear Passages''' — architecture, spies, or superstition; the town has never decided.

== Members (396 A.U.) ==
* '''[[Sabra Ravenshade]]''' (~44), head of house — the realm's best reader of people; charming, warm, unreadable.
* '''[[Emeric Ravenshade]]''' (~40), consort.
* '''[[Lyra Ravenshade]]''' (~22), heir — the house's envoy into the courts of the realm.
* '''[[Old Corvin]]''' (~70), archivist — loyal to the archive, not the family; he cannot be bought, which frightens everyone.
